name: Letting Go Of Hurt
overview: Scripture teaches that letting go of hurt involves trusting fully in God's unchanging promises and sovereignty, as He is faithful and will fulfill His word (Numbers 23:19). Believers are called to be still and recognize God's supreme authority amidst trials (Psalms 46:10), relying not on their own understanding but on the Lord with wholehearted trust (Proverbs 3:5). Practical wisdom encourages responding to anger with gentleness and patience, valuing discretion by deferring wrath and choosing to forgive offenses (Proverbs 15:1; 19:11). Moreover, Scripture exhorts believers to show kindness even to enemies, embodying Christlike love by meeting their needs rather than harboring resentment (Proverbs 25:21).
